goal: Build a reproducible synthetic fixture dataset and a deterministic media QA toolkit (probe + detectors) with tested technical findings.
nonGoals: Integrate with object storage or queues

acceptance.criterion: fixtures cover normal wrong_aspect short silent black freeze exact_duplicate and low_resolution
black freeze duration aspect resolution and audio checks are tested
fixtures are reproducible and copyright safe (lavfi only)

tests.command: fixture generator runs and writes dataset-manifest.json

rollback: synthetic fixtures are generated artifacts, not authoritative; worker modules segregated under frameflow-ai-worker.
fallback: metadata-only fixtures and capability detection if ffmpeg is unavailable.
